timeline.proxied: Shown in the web app, where requests go through the Gostman proxy.
timeline.reused: The connection of an earlier request was used again.
timeline.failedAt: {{label}} is the name of the phase in which the request failed, for example TCP connect.
timeline.reveal: Tooltip of the eye button that shows a hidden header value.
timeline.hide: Tooltip of the eye button that hides a header value again.
timeline.expanded: Accessible name of the button that collapses a row.
timeline.collapsed: Accessible name of the button that expands a row.
timeline.total: Label before the total of requests and scripts.
timeline.breakdown: Accessible name and tooltip heading of the bar that splits the time into phases.
timeline.breakdownProxied: Same heading when the proxy measured the times.
timeline.passed: Number of checks that passed in a script.
timeline.failed: Number of checks that failed in a script.
timeline.scriptFailed: Badge on a script that threw an error.
timeline.secrets: Row for secrets read from secret managers.
timeline.secretSkipped: {{name}} is a variable name; {{connection}} the name of a secret manager connection.
timeline.seconds: {{value}} is a number; s is the unit.
timeline.milliseconds: {{value}} is a number; ms is the unit.
timeline.phases: Phases of a request. The short name is used in tight places.
timeline.phases.firstByte: Time until the first byte of the response. TTFB is time to first byte.
timeline.facts: Labels of the details shown for one connection.
timeline.tlsAlpn: ALPN is the protocol negotiation of TLS; keep it.
timeline.tlsExpires: {{date}} is a date such as 2026-12-31 (kept in ISO form).
timeline.tlsExpired: Same, for a certificate that is already expired.
